messages.content: Return only JSON with keys priority, rationale, firstPatch, risk. You are independently prioritizing the next engineering bottleneck in an inference fabric. Facts: (1) a registry-priced concurrent JSONL dispatcher routes Groq, Gemini, OpenRouter, Claude, and future OpenAI-compatible Tailscale workers by expected verified-resolution cost; (2) a live 12-job run settled 12/12 JSON-schema-verified results at 74.10 jobs/min, with two automatic supplier fallbacks, but human audit found one schema-valid summary semantically weak; (3) the fabric is currently a CLI beside the advertised LISS ActivityStreams service, whose separate fixed three-tier route does not expose the registry market and stops on provider failure; (4) every batch still requires an incumbent to author job JSONL and launch a process; (5) Claude's local harness supports params.outputSchema, while the generic fabric currently sends params.response_format to every harness; (6) the target outcome is routine autonomous procurement by many colonies, not benchmark throughput. Choose exactly one priority from semantic-verification, service-face, continuous-queue, claude-schema-adapter, or other. Explain the smallest first patch and its principal risk in under 900 characters total.
